def factor_asym_intraday_vol_volume_conviction(df):
    """Asymmetric intraday volatility amplified by volume intensity."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["open"]) / df_copy["open"]
    down_sq = (intraday_ret.clip(upper=0) ** 2)
    up_sq = (intraday_ret.clip(lower=0) ** 2)
    down_vol = down_sq.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    up_vol = up_sq.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    raw_asym = down_vol - up_vol
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    factor = raw_asym * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_asym_intraday_vol_volume_conviction"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_asym_intraday_vol_volume_conviction"]
